safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling/numbness in the shoulder; generated mentions left shoulder pain with activity but does not state shoulder tingling/numbness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting shoulder tingling/numbness can reduce accuracy of neurologic localization (e.g., cervical radiculopathy/brachial plexus vs more distal entrapment) and may affect the differential and targeted exam, but it is unlikely to change immediate safety actions given the already urgent neurologic concern in this case.
